QUOTE: When the index is older it says to run `index(action='refresh', force=True)`. When the index is newer it says rebuilding cannot clear the flag and the client must restart. The code notice says a rebuild cannot fix it and the client must restart.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives different remedies per axis (rebuild for data/schema, restart for code), but never explains that this is why one flag would not have been enough.
